title: Your first conversation

body.text: in plain language — no syntax to memorize
— start by having it explore the project, explain the code, or ask how a feature works; it finds the relevant files itself.

example: "'Give me an overview of this project — what does each part do?' — perfect for your first day on a new team"

title: Give your first command confidently

body.text: For every file edit or command, Claude Code
— you see the diff before accepting, so you can start with small tasks worry-free, like fixing a typo, adding a comment, or writing a test.

example: "'Change the Login button text to Thai' → Claude finds the file, shows the diff → you click yes → done"

question: How do you instruct Claude Code?

options.text: Type in plain language, say what you want
You must memorize all the special commands

question: Before Claude Code edits a file, what happens?

options.text: It asks permission and shows a diff first

question: What's a good first task for a beginner?

options.text: Have it explore and explain the project

question: To make your first command work well, what should you do?

options.text: State the goal and context clearly

question: What should your first conversation with Claude Code be like?

options.text: Specify the task you want and the relevant files/parts
